detailed_description:
The target video is a 3D anime-style scene set in a cold, sterile hospital ward with soft early-morning white daylight slanting through the window, a desaturated pale-blue color palette, and handheld camera movement with rapid close-up cuts.
[Shot 1] The scene opens with a medium shot from the ward doorway. <Subject 1>, Gu Shen, carrying a double-layer silver thermos in his right hand, pushes the door open and steps into the hospital single ward. His footsteps slow as he sees <Subject 2>, Ruan Xiang, lying on the bed. A flicker of guilt crosses his eyes as he says, "怎么这么早就醒了？"
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the shot cuts to a medium shot beside the bed. <Subject 1> walks to the bedside cabinet and gently sets the silver thermos down. He reaches out to adjust <Subject 2>'s blanket corner and asks, "是不是哪里不舒服？" <Subject 2> looks at him and replies in a calm voice, "疼醒的。"
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>'s extended hand and <Subject 2>'s avoidance. <Subject 1> says, "让我看看," reaching toward <Subject 2>'s forehead. <Subject 2> slightly turns her head away, her fingers lightly gripping the blanket corner. <Subject 1>'s hand freezes in mid-air; his eyes flash with panic. After a few seconds of silence, he slowly withdraws his hand.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.200, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> unscrewing the thermos lid and pushing it toward <Subject 2>. He forces a gentle smile and says, "抱歉，昨晚配型库那边出了点系统故障，我处理到很晚。我给你带了张记的皮蛋瘦肉粥，你以前最爱吃的。" He opens the thermos and slides the congee forward.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.600, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2>'s face, immediately followed by <Subject 1>'s reaching hand. <Subject 2> wrinkles her nose at the smell, then suddenly covers her mouth and bends forward, dry-heaving. <Subject 1>'s expression shifts to alarm; he quickly screws the lid back on and reaches out to support her, calling out, "湘湘！" The frame ends with <Subject 2> bent over covering her mouth, dry-heaving, and <Subject 1> hastily capping the thermos while holding her.

The sound of a plastic thermos lid being unscrewed, dry-heaving sounds, hurried footsteps, and panicked dialogue continue throughout the scene.
